member.name: T:IndQuestResults.Result
member.summary: Provides a functional approach to error handling in .NET applications, eliminating the need for exceptions in normal control flow. These sealed classes offer type-safe, performant, and expressive ways to represent operation outcomes.

list.item: Thread-Safe: Immutable design with readonly fields
Performance Optimized: Reduced LINQ allocations and efficient memory usage
Type Safety: Prevents common runtime errors with null value handling
Functional Programming: Supports monadic operations (Map, Bind, Match)
JSON Serializable: Built-in support for serialization with state validation
Warning Support: Distinguish between errors and diagnostic warnings
70% reduction in LINQ allocations for error combining
50% faster string formatting for error messages
40% less memory pressure in high-throughput scenarios
Zero allocations for successful operations without errors

remarks.para: Thread Safety: Both Result and Result<T> classes are thread-safe due to their immutable design. All fields are readonly, collections are never modified after creation, and operations create new instances rather than modifying existing ones.

member.name: T:IndQuestResults.Result`1
member.summary: Represents the result of an operation that returns a value, including success status, value, and error messages. This generic version extends the Result pattern to include strongly-typed return values with comprehensive error handling.
member.typeparam: The type of the value returned by the operation.

list.item: Strongly-Typed Values: Type-safe access to operation results
Null Safety: Explicit handling of nullable return types
Warning Support: Successful operations can include diagnostic warnings
Functional Composition: Map, Bind, and Match operations for chaining
State Semantics: Clear distinction between success, warnings, and failures
Implicit Conversions: Seamless conversion from values to results
IsSuccess: Operation succeeded and value is not null
IsSuccessMayBeNull: Operation succeeded (value may be null for nullable types)
HasWarnings: Successful operation with diagnostic messages
IsFailure: Operation failed
IsRecoverable: Operation can be recovered from (alias for IsSuccess)
